changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fn_community_player_ids(p_player_id uuid) RETURNS TABLE (player_id uuid) LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$ WITH me AS ( SELECT p_player_id AS id WHERE p_player_id IS NOT NULL ), my_matches AS ( SELECT mp.match_id FROM match_participants mp JOIN me ON me.id = mp.player_id ), candidates AS ( SELECT id FROM me UNION SELECT CASE WHEN p.player1_id = me.id THEN p.player2_id ELSE p.player1_id END FROM partnerships p JOIN me ON me.id IN (p.player1_id, p.player2_id) UNION SELECT CASE WHEN t.owner_player_id = me.id THEN t.member_player_id ELSE t.owner_player_id END FROM team_ups t JOIN me ON me.id IN (t.owner_player_id, t.member_player_id) WHERE t.status = 'accepted' UNION -- Everyone who was on court, both sides of the net: this one -- branch is both "teammates" and "opponents". Verified only, -- since an unverified match is a claim, not yet a game. SELECT mp.player_id FROM match_participants mp JOIN my_matches mm ON mm.match_id = mp.match_id JOIN matches m ON m.id = mp.match_id WHERE m.status = 'verified' ) SELECT c.id FROM candidates c WHERE c.id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM player_relationships b WHERE b.relationship_type = 'block' AND b.status = 'active' AND ( (b.from_player_id = p_player_id AND b.to_player_id = c.id) OR (b.from_player_id = c.id AND b.to_player_id = p_player_id) ) ); $$;

rollback.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fn_community_player_ids(p_player_id uuid) RETURNS TABLE (player_id uuid) LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$ WITH me AS ( SELECT p_player_id AS id WHERE p_player_id IS NOT NULL ), my_clubs AS ( SELECT cm.club_id FROM club_memberships cm JOIN me ON me.id = cm.player_id WHERE cm.status = 'active' ), my_matches AS ( SELECT mp.match_id FROM match_participants mp JOIN me ON me.id = mp.player_id ), candidates AS ( SELECT id FROM me UNION SELECT pr.to_player_id FROM player_relationships pr JOIN me ON me.id = pr.from_player_id WHERE pr.relationship_type = 'follow' AND pr.status = 'active' UNION SELECT CASE WHEN p.player1_id = me.id THEN p.player2_id ELSE p.player1_id END FROM partnerships p JOIN me ON me.id IN (p.player1_id, p.player2_id) UNION SELECT CASE WHEN t.owner_player_id = me.id THEN t.member_player_id ELSE t.owner_player_id END FROM team_ups t JOIN me ON me.id IN (t.owner_player_id, t.member_player_id) WHERE t.status = 'accepted' UNION SELECT mp.player_id FROM match_participants mp JOIN my_matches mm ON mm.match_id = mp.match_id JOIN matches m ON m.id = mp.match_id WHERE m.status = 'verified' UNION SELECT cm.player_id FROM club_memberships cm JOIN my_clubs mc ON mc.club_id = cm.club_id WHERE cm.status = 'active' ) SELECT c.id FROM candidates c WHERE c.id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM player_relationships b WHERE b.relationship_type = 'block' AND b.status = 'active' AND ( (b.from_player_id = p_player_id AND b.to_player_id = c.id) OR (b.from_player_id = c.id AND b.to_player_id = p_player_id) ) ); $$;
